headline: Petroperú Secures $475 Million Bridge Loan to Keep Talara Refinery Running
summary: Peru's state-owned oil company Petroperú received a $475 million bridge loan, with 57% allocated for crude and fuel supplies to maintain operations at the Talara refinery.
why: Petroperú is the state oil company of Peru, and its financial stability is vital for the country's domestic fuel supply and sovereign credit assessment.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Securing liquidity prevents immediate operational shutdowns at critical national refineries.
